description: Sequencer mods for the Perkons HD-01 (tested on hardware)

mods.title: MICROTIMING
mods.summary: TESTED ON HARDWARE. HOLD A STEP AND TURN TEMPO TO PLAY IT EARLY OR LATE, IN SIXTHS OF A STEP. SWITCHED ON IN THE CONFIG MENU, ROW 3 STEP 12.

controls.does: HOLD A STEP, TURN TEMPO: PLAYS THE STEP EARLY OR LATE
